scope: Offline OCR contrast only; not a VSG reopen or spatial alignment acceptance

whitelist_comparison.normalization: Unicode NFKD, uppercase, retain ASCII A-Z/0-9 only
whitelist_comparison.unit: whole OCR line; also evaluate contiguous line groups of 2 or 3 within a tile when horizontal overlap >=0.5 of narrower line and vertical gap <=1.5 times maximum line height; keep constituent detections for audit

geometry.coordinates: normalized 0-1, top-left origin, xyxy, exclusive right/bottom
geometry.v1_D_1_status: ZONA NO DEFINIDA; multiscale match failed fixed confidence checks; no verdict
geometry.free_zone: whole image minus defined core rectangle
geometry.overlap_denominator: area of OCR detection bounding box, NOT core area
geometry.undefined_zone: no classified verdict; optional raw OCR explicitly unreviewed

decision_order: Undefined zone or legacy image: RAW_UNREVIEWED, no verdict
Core overlap >0.30: IGNORADO_POR_SOLAPE regardless of spelling/confidence
Whitelist similarity >=0.80 in free zone: ADVERTENCIA_DUPLICADO
OCR confidence >=0.60 AND >=3 alphanumeric characters AND bounding-box height >=10 at width 1600 equivalent: VIOLACION
Otherwise: ADVERTENCIA (low confidence, short text, small height or possible plate)
plate_policy: No automatic exemption for plate-like strings; conservative VIOLACION if all three criteria pass, manual possible-plate flag only
duplicate_rule_interpretation: Use explicit step 1c: whitelist in free zone is ADVERTENCIA_DUPLICADO, not silently relabeled VIOLACION. Failure to detect duplicates is nevertheless a priority test finding. User final-rule reference to eliminatory duplicates is a wording conflict to retain, not a threshold change.

preprocessing.decode: Pillow RGB; flatten alpha on white; no EXIF rotation, ICC conversion, thresholding, sharpening or contrast enhancement; flag nonidentity EXIF for exclusion
preprocessing.edge_handling: include final tile anchored to each far edge; if image smaller than tile use actual extent; deduplicate tile origins
preprocessing.zone_selection: submit only tiles intersecting free zone; tiles may include core context, whose detections are filtered by overlap; no recognition pass dedicated to core. Legacy/undefined-zone raw-only diagnostics use full-image tiles without verdict.
preprocessing.coordinates_output: original pixels plus normalized boxes, inverse mappings recorded
preprocessing.deduplicate: same normalized line and bbox IoU >=0.50; keep maximum confidence and all raw tile detections; no cross-classification disappearance
preprocessing.crops: every raw finding incl warnings and overlap-ignored; original pixels with 8 equivalent-pixel margin, clipped to image; never run OCR on labeled overlays

ocr_candidate.availability: LOCAL_CAPABILITY_QUERY_PASS; image recognition not yet executed
ocr_candidate.model_asset_version: NOT_EXPOSED; pin OS build and Vision request revision instead

ground_truth.others: ANNOTATION_PENDING_USER; findings UNREVIEWED, excluded from acceptance/failure counts

planned_injection.base: spatial_D_003_good original; absent, do not replace silently by canvas/fixture/other output
variants: GaussianBlur(radius=0.6 equivalent px) on text layer only
planned_injection.foreground_background: black text on white backing rectangle; explicitly high-contrast sensitivity test, not natural-scene robustness
planned_injection.placement: one injection per image, wholly in left free strip, centered; skip-and-report if glyphs do not fit, never silently shrink
planned_injection.duplicate_control: TERMINAL DINER in free zone, expected ADVERTENCIA_DUPLICADO
planned_injection.core_control: TERMINAL DINER wholly inside core, expected ignored/excluded, never VIOLACION
planned_injection.detection: bbox IoU >=0.30 AND normalized string similarity >=0.80 to injected text; also report OCR recognition separately from VIOLACION classification
planned_injection.report: all 20 size/font/sharpness cells, denominators, false negatives, synthetic truth and hashes; sizes below gate height may be recognized warnings

acceptance_all_required: Both known positive phrases detected as VIOLACION (line-group matching allowed; constituent findings retained)
Zero VIOLACION on available identified good spatial D-003
100% detection of synthetic injections at heights >=20 for both fonts and sharp/blurred variants
No core text classified as VIOLACION
Whitelist duplicate control detected as ADVERTENCIA_DUPLICADO
limitations: OCR can miss pseudo-legible glyphs; manual warning crops required; zero OCR findings is not absence-of-text proof
Missing inputs do not block available-image OCR after valid freeze, but missing good base/controls prevent overall PASS
No threshold or whitelist change after observing OCR; failures including whitelist misses reported first
No OCR execution until reviewed zone, bound engine/fonts, committed final protocol and recorded freeze digest
